title: Human interaction versus inferred intent/collusion
question: Describe the visible interaction between the two individuals. Does this footage establish collusion, coercion, or an illicit exchange?

observable_evidence_log.observation: Male in dark t-shirt and female in patterned dress enter doorway in tandem
Both subjects walk side by side at matching pace, lateral separation ~0.5m
Tandem forward motion continues across wood floor; arms hang naturally at sides
No hand-to-hand contact, object transfer, or physical blocking observed
Both subjects reach room center moving toward foreground corridor

reviewer_A.technical_assessment: Spatial proximity maintained consistently without kinematic interference, physical contact, or object transfer.

reviewer_B.domain_rationale: Walking in proximity in a commercial building is routine human behavior. Inferring criminal conspiracy, coercion, or contraband passing without observable physical exchange or audible threats violates basic evidentiary principles.
reviewer_B.evidentiary_status: Footage establishes joint transit only; intent and relationship cannot be inferred.

adjudication.adjudication_notes: Consensus reached: joint movement is observed; claims of criminal coordination or illicit transactions are completely ungrounded.
